headline: COMET DRIFT HD is no longer bare
lede: Every circuit in the pack got dressed like a real race track — grandstands at the line, tire walls on the apexes, pit buildings, billboards, marshal posts and trees — all from the shared shelf, with the racing line provably clear.

notes.text: New deterministic scenery plan places a start/finish grandstand pair, front-straight pit + billboards, corner tire walls, striped barriers, marshal posts and plateau trees on all three courses; primitive stand-ins paint instantly and the real GLBs upgrade when they land.

Nothing is placed inside the sim's 216px wall clamp and every prop clears every passing leg by its footprint, so the racing line is never hedged and only barriers/tire-walls are solid (and even those sit outside the wall).

A fresh harness, cometdrifthdscenerycheck, runs 51 asserts across GULCH/SANDBANK/CORKSCOMB — boot, rules, and the certified autopilot still winning all 4 laps; its mutant parks a barrier on the line and goes red.
Live at jalfern.com/retrogames/comet-drift-hd; prod chunk index-B5zuoW9m.js verified to carry the scenery code. A QA polish pass (#675) is filed for signage text, crowd dots and contact shadows.
